questions.q: Why can system integration testing (SIT) pass while user acceptance testing (UAT) still uncovers problems?
options: SIT confirms technical correctness; UAT confirms real business users can actually do their jobs, which a technically correct workflow can still fail at
SIT and UAT always test the exact same things, so this cannot happen
UAT is performed before SIT in every implementation
UAT only tests report formatting, nothing else
questions.explain: SIT is largely a technical/process check run by the project team. UAT tests whether the client's own users can actually perform their real workflows - a gap SIT often cannot see.

questions.q: Why does the balancing segment on the chart of accounts matter for intercompany activity?
options: It has no connection to intercompany activity at all
It is only used for tax reporting, not for consolidation
It must net to zero for each legal entity, which is what makes intercompany elimination in consolidation possible
It determines which users can see which journals
questions.explain: The balancing segment (Company, in the capstone's design) must net to zero per legal entity. Without that discipline, intercompany balances can't cleanly eliminate in consolidation.

questions.q: What makes "I'm not a developer, but I've built FBDI loads and written reconciliation SQL" a strong answer to "how technical are you?"
options: It avoids the question entirely
It claims full software development expertise
It is only acceptable if the interviewer is also a developer
It is precise and specific rather than either inflating or underselling actual technical comfort
questions.explain: The strongest answer is honest and specific - naming real experience (FBDI, SQL, OTBI, BI Publisher) without overclaiming developer-level skill.

questions.q: A client says an AR aging report looks wrong. What is the recommended first step?
options: Assume the report itself is broken and rebuild it from scratch
Immediately reverse every receipt posted that month
Tell the client the report is correct without checking anything
Pull the transaction detail behind the summary and check the specific invoices and their receipt applications
questions.explain: Rather than assuming the report is wrong, the right first step is pulling the underlying detail to determine whether the issue is a timing difference or a genuine misapplication.

questions.q: A batch of subledger transactions shows accounting status Incomplete. Where should you look first?
options: The company's annual report
The user's email inbox
The general ledger's calendar setup
The Create Accounting error details for one specific transaction, which usually name a missing account rule mapping
questions.explain: Create Accounting's error detail for a specific transaction usually points directly at the missing piece, most often a missing account rule mapping.

questions.q: What is the main thing an interviewer is listening for in a scenario-based question?
options: Whether you recite a memorized textbook definition
Your reasoning process and how you arrive at a defensible recommendation, not one single 'correct' answer
Whether you can answer without pausing to think at all
Whether you agree with everything the interviewer suggests
questions.explain: Scenario questions usually have no single correct answer. The interviewer wants to see clarifying questions, reasoning, and a defensible recommendation.

questions.q: When asked to design a chart of accounts for a two-legal-entity company, what should your answer lead with?
options: The GL's technical table structure
The requirement that each entity must stand alone and still consolidate cleanly
The exact segment names, before mentioning any business requirement
A claim that one chart of accounts can never serve two legal entities
questions.explain: Strong answers start from the business requirement - each entity needs to stand alone and consolidate - then explain which segment (the balancing segment) makes that possible.

questions.q: What did the CFO's six January 31 symptoms actually represent, before investigation?
options: Six confirmed root causes already fully diagnosed
Observed symptoms - a CFO's description of what looked wrong - not yet diagnosed root causes
A list of software bugs in Oracle Fusion itself
Six unrelated issues with no connection to the books at all
questions.explain: Elena Marsh's six statements described symptoms in her own words. The actual root causes behind each one had to be investigated and confirmed, not assumed.

questions.q: Which of these is listed as a recommended next step for the weeks right after finishing this course?
options: Immediately claim an Oracle certification without taking any exam
Pick a certification target and map a study plan against its current, real objectives
Stop practicing hands-on configuration entirely now that the course is done
Avoid applying to any roles until certification is fully complete
questions.explain: The lesson recommends picking a certification target and mapping a real study plan, alongside finishing portfolio artifacts and starting to apply using the resume and capstone story already built.

questions.q: Why does this lesson say it's credible, not weak, to admit the capstone doesn't fully replace real client experience?
options: Because the capstone experience is completely irrelevant to a real consulting role
Because it is dishonest to ever mention training experience in a professional setting
Because an honest acknowledgment of the capstone's real value and its real limits is a mature, credible answer that builds confidence rather than undermining it
Because admitting any limitation always destroys credibility immediately
questions.explain: The lesson frames honest self-assessment - naming what the capstone really gave you and what it didn't - as a mature, credible answer, not a weakness.

questions.q: Why are Oracle Cloud Applications exam codes often versioned to a specific year?
options: Because Oracle Cloud Applications update continuously, so exam content is refreshed periodically to match the current state of the product
Because older exam codes are illegal to use
Because Oracle changes exam codes randomly with no connection to the product
Because exam codes are year-versioned only for marketing purposes
questions.explain: Unlike older, fixed-version on-premise software, Oracle Cloud Applications update continuously, so exam codes are refreshed to match current product content.

questions.q: What three things does a strong resume bullet name explicitly, according to this lesson's formula?
options: The course title, the instructor's name, and the completion date
The action taken, the system or area it was done in, and the resulting outcome
Only the name of the software, repeated three times
The company's revenue, employee count, and founding year
questions.explain: The action-system-outcome formula names what you did, where you did it, and what resulted - far stronger than a vague restatement of a course title.

questions.q: Which portfolio artifact is described as being entirely your own original writing, and therefore safe to share?
options: A screenshot of a live Oracle Fusion instance
A copy of Oracle's own internal documentation
A requirements and configuration workbook written in your own words
A recording of someone else's licensed training session
questions.explain: A requirements/configuration workbook, an issue log, original SQL, and a case study write-up are all your own original writing - unlike a screenshot of licensed software.

questions.q: When answering 'tell me about a time you made a mistake,' where should most of the answer's weight go?
options: Entirely on detailed excuses for why the mistake wasn't really your fault
On minimizing the mistake so it sounds unimportant
On naming every other person who was also partially responsible
On what you changed afterward, after plainly owning the mistake in one sentence
questions.explain: A believable answer owns the mistake plainly and briefly, then spends the majority of the answer on what specifically changed as a result.

questions.q: What is the real purpose of a practice exam, according to this lesson's three-question readiness check?
options: It is the entire study plan by itself
It replaces the need to ever configure anything hands-on
It guarantees a passing score on the real exam
It is a readiness check that reveals where gaps remain - it does not fill those gaps itself
questions.explain: A practice exam score tells you where you're weak. It does not teach you the material - that still requires hands-on review and practice.
